purpose: UI concept illustrations; not runtime assets or gameplay definitions

prompts.title: 01-hud
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-end art-directed 16:9 full-frame in-game MMORPG HUD concept for Project G, a stylized hand-painted anime 3D fantasy world, high-angle isometric camera, spring Linvel coastal gardens, moss green grass, flowering trees, stone footpath, soft painted cel shading, a small brown-haired traveler in navy scarf and travel coat in the middle. Actual coherent GAME SCREEN, not a web dashboard, not an annotated presentation. Render at 1920x1080 or larger. UI style: sophisticated smoked deep teal #10282F and dark blue green #18343A surfaces, warm ivory typography, restrained thin antique gold #B99B62 outlines, tiny precise decorative corners, crisp clean spacing; attractive premium fantasy UI, light quiet ornament, no oversized beige panels, no chunky plastic blue buttons, no giant navigation banner.
Strict layout: Top left a compact round portrait medallion of the same traveler, with three elegant slim staggered dark teal pointed gold rimmed resource plates stretching right. Labels exactly "Здоровье", "Мана", "Выносливость", red cyan amber fills with small subtle numeric values. Entire top-left block less than 23 percent of screen width and 14 percent height, closely composed, face clearly visible.
Top RIGHT fully INSIDE screen 32px safe margins, a circular 210px minimap occupying a square with north tick. This must show actual painted terrain corresponding to central scene, paths grass and trees, NOT a blank disk. Put one bright ivory player arrow exactly in minimap center; terrain surrounds the center symmetrically, cropped by circle; subtle fog at unexplored edge. Place "Буковая долина" below in neat small text. No side panel full of coordinates. Nothing extends outside frame.
Bottom center: eight compact square skill icons Q W E R A S D F and a separated smaller dodge icon Space, rich hand-painted ability icons without repeated labels saying ready. Thin experience line below. Leave center and bottom left completely clear to see gameplay. Lower right a modest horizontal row of SIX small unboxed ivory outline icons with occasional small key hints for character inventory journal guild map menu, no big labels, no backdrop strip. No quest tracker. No world events box, no text like "События мира", no "Здесь появятся", no "Журнал поручений", no "Подойдите к NPC", no world notices, no tutorial text, no slogan, no chat, no fake invitations. Most screen is visible game world. This is a polished attainable desktop Godot game UI, not a magical ornate painting. Consistent readable Cyrillic text. No watermark.

prompts.title: 02-character
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE extremely polished 16:9 game screenshot concept of the CHARACTER SCREEN for Project G stylized hand-painted anime 3D MMORPG. Background is softly defocused lush spring coastal woodland from a high-angle fantasy game, visible in generous outer margins. Main window centered occupying about 80 percent width and 80 percent height, entirely inside safe edges. Premium clean fantasy material language: translucent smoked DEEP TEAL #10282F and dark green blue #18343A, warm ivory text, restrained antique gold #B99B62 single hairline outlines and selected accents, very limited ornament, refined modern typesetting with complete Cyrillic. Do NOT use a huge beige parchment rectangle, blue pill buttons, a generic browser/dashboard sidebar or nested boxes everywhere.
Header top left "Персонаж", a short secondary line "Путешественник · Уровень 1"; top right a small elegant X. Under heading a HORIZONTAL quiet local tab row "Облик и снаряжение" selected gold underline, "Характеристики", "Навыки", "Профессия". No global left sidebar menu.
Left 60 percent of content is a magnificent readable full-body presentation of the brown-haired male traveler, young adult, navy scarf, practical layered travel coat and boots, simple sword sheathed, neutral relaxed three-quarter pose in a subtle diffuse light pool. This is concept character art, not a capsule or silhouette. Equip slots in two neat slim vertical columns around the model, chest gloves weapon boots belt, maximum 8, several empty with very subtle engraved symbols. No slot labels crowding model.
Right 35 percent is a tightly organized character summary using clean text rows, spacing and a few small symbols: "Характеристики", "Сила 10", "Ловкость 10", "Живучесть 10", "Интеллект 10", "Сноровка 10", "Удача 10", "Мудрость 10". Values aligned right. Three derived rows "Здоровье", "Мана", "Защита" in a quieter section. Do not put plus/minus controls on this overview tab. Bottom right one restrained outlined action "Распределить очки" with small badge "18"; do not activate a fake application if no draft. Footer minimal "K / Esc · Закрыть". Good whitespace but no huge empty blocks. Important: use proportional compact typographic hierarchy, not gigantic text. Screen must feel in same UI family as elegant teal gold round avatar health bars. No bright decorative magical circles. No other screens, no collage, no watermark. Full art direction and accurate usable layout.

prompts.title: 03-inventory
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity 16:9 in-game INVENTORY and equipment UI concept for Project G, a stylized hand-painted anime 3D fantasy MMORPG. A blurred sunlit spring forest garden is visible behind a centered floating window at about 85 percent width, 82 percent height. Visual system rigorously: smoked deep teal #10282F and dark blue green #18343A surfaces, warm ivory text, antique muted gold #B99B62 thin strokes, subtle material noise, elegant small corners, modern crisp Cyrillic typography and strict spacing. Premium calm fantasy UI, NOT a beige old-fashioned form, NOT a blue-and-gold toy app, not web or mobile dashboard. Window top header "Инвентарь", small X close at right, small section tabs "Сумка" selected underline and "Снаряжение". No global vertical sidebar.
Layout: Left column about 27 percent wide showing a compact full-body brown-haired male traveler in navy scarf practical coat and boots, with a few neatly arranged worn gear slots around him and caption "Снаряжение". Center 43 percent: compact search field "Поиск", filter chips "Все", "Оружие", "Броня", "Материалы"; a beautiful precisely aligned six-column by five-row grid of square item slots, 15 filled with hand-painted sword shield leather gloves boots cloak ore herb potion icons, rest honestly empty dark recessed squares. Consistent restrained thin rarity borders, small stack counts lower right, selected sword outlined warm gold; no rainbow glows. Grid has room to breathe and doesn't touch boundaries. Capacity text "15 / 30" small below.
Right column 30 percent is a clean selected-item detail area with no nested rounded cards: large sword illustration, short name exactly "Железный меч", subtype "Одноручное оружие", two or three short aligned values e.g. "Урон 12–16" and "Прочность 84 / 100", fine divider, a short flavor line, a primary subdued gold action "Экипировать", secondary text action "Выбросить". Do not use invented monetization or premium currencies. Footer faint mouse and keyboard action hints, no excessive instruction text. Selected item's art and details unambiguously correspond to the highlighted grid sword. A coherent beautiful shippable game interface, no extra inset screenshots, no annotations, no watermark.

prompts.title: 04-other-screens
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE large 16:9 art director concept sheet with FOUR clear equal game UI screenshots in a tidy 2 by 2 grid, thin neutral dark separator between images. This is a deliberate UI family presentation for Project G hand-painted anime 3D fantasy MMORPG. All four show the SAME premium design language: smoked deep teal #10282F, blue green #18343A, warm ivory crisp Cyrillic text, antique gold #B99B62 hairline separators/selected underlines, restrained decoration, small elegant X closes, blurred spring forest outer background margins. Never huge beige forms, blue plastic pill buttons, massive global left navigation or fantasy baroque clutter. The UI windows have content relevant to each screen, NOT repeated generic layout. Render fine readable detail at high resolution.
TOP LEFT: title "Карта". Map of explored LOCAL forests and stone roads dominates 80 percent of window, painted cartographic texture in green gold ivory, not a random continent; small ivory current player arrow center; unexplored border fading into dark mist, very few landmark icons, north mark, small +/- zoom at bottom, quiet "К персонажу" recenter control. A narrow legend area. No map routing arrows, no fast travel, no omniscient secret locations, no coordinates soup.
TOP RIGHT: title "Журнал". Clean list of three simple known entries on left 30 percent, selected "Дорога к долине"; readable detail in right 70 percent with heading, short description, one simple objective line and reward footer. Quiet local tabs "Активные" selected and "Завершённые". One restrained button "Отслеживать". Dense enough to be useful, no giant empty panels or scrollbars on empty space. Simple text is illustrative only.
BOTTOM LEFT: title "Эхо". Designed EMPTY STATE, tasteful faint star emblem at center, short exact text "У вас пока нет Эхо", a quiet explanatory sentence. Three empty understated ACTIVE slots at bottom, not unlocked or purchasable, no fake owned heroes, no portraits, no gambling buttons, no invented currencies, no affinity metrics. Empty state feels intentional and complete.
BOTTOM RIGHT: title "Гильдия авантюристов". Known-notice board, ordered compact list left, one selected notice with readable heading right, small public task seals. Caption "Известные поручения". No rank progress bar or numeric rank, no accept/reward claim buttons: a quiet action "Открыть журнал" and text "Подробности у собеседника". This screen presents known information, no new gameplay system.
All four distinct layouts must be attractive serious desktop game UI. Avoid wordy gibberish. No logos, no watermark. Do not include any HUD slogans or world events placeholders.
